definitions: To interpret or understand the meaning of written or printed words or symbols.
To speak aloud written or printed words.
To study or learn from written material.
To show or indicate a particular measurement or value (e.g., a thermometer reads a certain temperature).
To have a particular wording or content.
examples: She can read a book in one sitting.
He read the story to the children.
I need to read up on this topic.
